# openstatus Provider

The OpenStatus provider allows you to manage monitors, status pages, and notifications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "openstatus" {
  # Set via OPENSTATUS_API_TOKEN environment variable or here:
  # api_token = "your-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) OpenStatus API token. Can also be set via the `OPENSTATUS_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL for the OpenStatus API. Defaults to `https://api.openstatus.dev/rpc`.
